hints.title: Aggregated Metrics
hints.text: Track two attributes per creator: their cumulative view count, and their highest-viewed video.

hints.title: Tie-Breaking Invariant
hints.text: For individual videos of the same creator, break ties by selecting the lexicographically smaller video id.

hints.title: Maximal Filter
hints.text: Find the maximum cumulative view count among all creators, then collect all creators attaining this maximum.

hints.title: Cumulative Tracking Implementation

variables: l: average length of creator and video strings
complexity.notes: Single pass iteration with dictionary accumulation and tie breaking.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Sorting the entire list of videos lexicographically and by views repeatedly is needlessly slow.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n * l) storage for creator totals and best video references.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Carefully handles lexicographical tie-breaking alongside cumulative sums.
